name: Yến sào
summary: Swiftlet nests from islands in the bay. The tourism bureau says Hòn Nội is the nest island, with a temple to the trade and a restaurant that serves dishes made from the nests. Vietnam Tourism says Yến Island, also called Yen Sao Island. Both names stay.
origin: Islands in Nha Trang Bay. Hòn Nội on the bureau page. Yến Island on Vietnam Tourism.
howToEat: The bureau page says the island restaurant serves dishes made from the nests, and that people take home raw nests, cleaned nests, and nest drinks, including the product name Sanest.
It does not describe a texture. Check the cup on arrival.
where: Hòn Nội on the bureau page. The restaurant is not given a separate name.
seoTitle: Yến sào — swiftlet nests from Nha Trang Bay
seoDescription: The bureau page’s nest island is Hòn Nội. Vietnam Tourism says Yến Island. Products named are raw nests, cleaned nests, and nest drinks.
